Example meta-analysis data

Source: R/data.R
forestmap_example.Rd

Made-up studies from a meta-analysis of an intervention: each study's standardised mean difference with its 95% confidence interval, its sample size, and four study properties. Some studies don't report their outcome measure or country (NA). Use it to try out plot_forestmap().

Usage

forestmap_example

Format

A data frame with 60 rows (studies) and 9 columns:

study

Study label (first author and year).

smd

Standardised mean difference (Hedges' g).

ci_lower, ci_upper

Lower and upper bounds of its 95% confidence interval.

n

Total sample size.

population

Factor: Adults, Children or Clinical.

outcome

Factor: Self-report or Behavioural; NA = not reported.

design

Factor: RCT or Quasi-experimental.

country

Factor: USA, UK, Australia, Germany or Canada; NA = not reported.

Source

Simulated; see data-raw/forestmap_example.R in the package source.
